name: check-cycle
title: Check Cycle
description: Rotating words beside a checkbox: a sentence that finishes itself several ways. "Create your own" sits left of a ticked shadcn-style checkbox and the word to its right rolls up out of a slot — Intros, Demos, Launches, Changelogs, Tutorials, And more — then the line steps back a little and rests. Every number came off a recording, frame by frame: the two words in the slot move as one strip on the in-out cubic over exactly half a second, a roll every twenty frames. The type moves by fractions of a pixel instead of the whole-pixel steps a browser snaps text to.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/check-cycle?ref=cli — headline is the part of the sentence that never changes; words is what finishes it, comma separated, rolled through in order beside a ticked checkbox, then the line steps back to 80% and rests. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette. — 76 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/docs/pricing?ref=cli-docs
